briefing.headline: US-China chip export curbs intensify as OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4 race toward multi-agent AGI thresholds.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid tightening compute supply chains and regulatory scrutiny. US export controls on advanced chips are reshaping alliances while model capabilities advance rapidly in reasoning and autonomy.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI debuts o4 with enhanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; Google releases Gemini 3 Pro and Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-V3 push inference efficiency boundaries.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF 2.0 with mandatory red-teaming for frontier models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Arizona. TSMC Arizona fab yields improve for custom AI ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged 10^26 FLOP training run trigger mandatory international oversight by 2027?
